svg.title: YETENEK 2.0
svg.desc: YETENEK 2.0 — 2nd place · METU Sports Tech Hackathon 2026. A phone camera screens kids aged 8–15 for sports talent: MediaPipe scores a 5-minute test, Claude picks 3–5 of 12 sports and flags injury risk. 5 min test battery; 12 sport profiles; 0 videos uploaded (landmarks only). Stack: Next.js, MediaPipe, Claude, Supabase.
